subject: Frank v0.1 Harness repository/materialization truth boundary

frank.message: Prompt path already has strong repo/materialization truth validation; legacy Harness controller has a code-supported direct open_pair compatibility path. Reproduce on newest Ubuntu checkout and close at canonical entry boundary if confirmed.

harness.message: Add fail-closed preflight before canonical Harness access; fault-inject stale/graph-stale/migration/degraded states and prove zero mutation; measure PASS/recovery latency.

unifieddb.message: Keep semantic authority and explicit materialization lineage. WAL multi-file crash atomicity is not guaranteed; do not infer coherence from file-open success.

claygraph.message: Derived/rebuildable graph still requires current source semantic epoch + projection lineage before use; stale graph should fail closed then rebuild/rescue.

claycode.message: No BASE PASS credit. Preserve explicit effect/authority and rollback semantics; consider expressing guarded-entry/failure receipts in executable ClayCode only after the current compiler/runtime path can execute them.

gwt.message: For state/memory evaluation, separate retrieval/delivery/reconstruction/use/effect/reentry; do not mint one memory/GWT scalar as truth.

emergenz.message: Use lesion/rescue and zero-mutation controls around the safety gate; recurrence or successful recovery alone is not emergence evidence.

hyperposition.message: Preserve alternatives: wrapper-only, controller-integrated gate, or packaging/service single-entry enforcement remain OPEN until Ubuntu evidence discriminates.

clayresearch.message: Localized integration gap found; broader repo-first architecture is stronger than initial hypothesis. Prioritize Ubuntu reproduction over speculative redesign.
